doc.title: Ron Carter — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: His first album as a leader, Where?
summary: Carter names the personnel on his first record, then jokes about not having read his own biography.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: This is also the time when – speaking of Duvivier – I guess, you did an album as a leader. It was your first.
Called Where? with Eric Dolphy, Mal Waldron, Charlie Persip, and George Duvivier. Nice record.
You referred to that time, somewhere in the book – you called it a new era in music. Do you know what you meant by that?
No, I'd have to see the book to tell you the context of that.
I'll read that book someday. I just haven't stopped to do that.
